nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: 顶层包入口，空文件——仅将 `neuropy` 标记为 Python package，子模块由使用方显式 import。

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Analyses 层的 barrel：re-export artifact / brainstates / decoders / oscillations / placefields / reactivation 等分析模块，形成 `from neuropy.analyses import ...` 的统一入口。

nodes.name: artifact.py
nodes.summary: Detects movement/electrical artifact periods in LFP by z-scoring signal deviation and thresholding, returning them as an Epoch object for downstream masking.

nodes.name: detect_artifact_epochs
nodes.summary: Thresholds z-scored LFP deviation over sliding bins to mark artifact-contaminated intervals and merges them into an Epoch.

nodes.name: brainstates.py
nodes.summary: Sleep/wake state scoring: 从 LFP 反推 EMG（相关性法），结合 theta/delta 比值与运动量将 session 切分为 NREM / REM / QW / AW 等 brainstate epochs。

nodes.name: emg_from_LFP
nodes.summary: Estimates a pseudo-EMG trace by computing pairwise high-frequency correlations across spatially separated LFP channels.

nodes.name: detect_brainstates_epochs
nodes.summary: Clusters theta/delta ratio and EMG features via thresholding to label continuous NREM/REM/quiet-wake/active-wake epochs.

nodes.name: decoders.py
nodes.summary: Bayesian position decoding from spike trains plus replay-sequence scoring (radon transform, weighted correlation, jump distance) with shuffle-based significance.

nodes.name: radon_transform
nodes.summary: Scores a posterior probability matrix by finding the best-fitting line through it (Radon transform), yielding replay velocity and score.

nodes.name: wcorr
nodes.summary: Computes the probability-weighted correlation between decoded position and time for a posterior matrix.

nodes.name: jump_distance
nodes.summary: Measures maximum bin-to-bin jump in decoded position, used to reject discontinuous replay candidates.

nodes.name: column_shift
nodes.summary: Generates column-cycled shuffles of a posterior matrix for null-distribution construction.

nodes.name: Decode1d
nodes.summary: 1D Bayesian decoder: builds a firing-rate template from a Pf1D ratemap, decodes posteriors over epochs, and scores sequences against shuffles with p-values and plots.

nodes.name: neurons_correlation.py
nodes.summary: Small helper computing pairwise neuron correlation matrices in sliding time windows across a session.

nodes.name: corr_across_time_window
nodes.summary: Bins spikes into windows and returns the neuron-by-neuron correlation matrix per window.

nodes.name: neurons_stability.py
nodes.summary: Cluster-quality / stability metrics for sorted units: firing-rate stability, ISI stability, refractory-period violations, isolation distance.

nodes.name: firing_rate_stability
nodes.summary: Flags units whose binned firing rate stays above a threshold fraction of the session, marking them as stable.

nodes.name: isi_stability
nodes.summary: Assesses stability by comparing inter-spike-interval distributions across session chunks.

nodes.name: refPeriodViolation
nodes.summary: Computes refractory-period violation rate per unit as a contamination proxy.

nodes.name: oscillations.py
nodes.summary: LFP 振荡事件检测总库：通用 band-pass + 阈值 epoch 检测器，衍生出 ripple / sharp-wave / theta / spindle / delta / beta / gamma 专用探测函数，外加 Ripple 与 Gamma 分析类。

nodes.name: get_bandpass_power
nodes.summary: Band-pass filters a signal and returns its smoothed Hilbert amplitude envelope.

nodes.name: _detect_freq_band_epochs
nodes.summary: Generic engine behind every band detector: z-scores band power across channels, applies low/high thresholds and duration constraints to emit candidate Epochs.

nodes.name: detect_hpc_delta_wave_epochs
nodes.summary: Detects hippocampal delta waves via zero-crossing/peak-trough criteria on filtered LFP.

nodes.name: detect_beta_epochs
nodes.summary: Wraps the generic band detector with beta-band parameters to return beta epochs.

nodes.name: detect_ripple_epochs
nodes.summary: Detects sharp-wave ripple events (~150-250 Hz) with channel selection and duration/threshold gating.

nodes.name: detect_sharpwave_epochs
nodes.summary: Detects low-frequency sharp-wave deflections accompanying ripples.

nodes.name: detect_theta_epochs
nodes.summary: Detects theta-dominant periods, optionally requiring an elevated theta/delta ratio.

nodes.name: detect_spindle_epochs
nodes.summary: Detects sleep spindles in the 10-16 Hz band using the shared band-epoch detector.

nodes.name: Ripple
nodes.summary: Object-oriented wrapper around ripple detection adding mean-wavelet spectra and peak ripple-frequency estimation.

nodes.name: Gamma
nodes.summary: Gamma-band analysis helper providing peak-interval extraction and current source density computation.

nodes.name: placefields.py
nodes.summary: Place-field estimation for 1D and 2D environments: occupancy-normalized ratemaps, theta-phase precession, split-session stability, plus a rich set of ratemap/raster plotting methods.

nodes.name: Pf1Dsplit
nodes.summary: Splits a session into blocks, builds a Pf1D per block, and correlates their ratemaps to quantify place-field stability.

nodes.name: Pf1D
nodes.summary: Core 1D place-field class: computes occupancy-normalized smoothed tuning curves from Neurons+Position and exposes peak/width metrics and many plot helpers.

nodes.name: Pf2D
nodes.summary: 2D analogue of Pf1D producing spatial ratemaps over an open field with map/raster plotting utilities.

nodes.name: reactivation.py
nodes.summary: Memory-reactivation analyses: explained-variance (EV/REV) across pre/task/post epochs and PCA/ICA cell-assembly (ensemble) extraction with activation strength over time.

nodes.name: ExplainedVariance
nodes.summary: Computes explained variance and reverse explained variance between pairwise correlation matrices of pre/maze/post epochs, with plotting.

nodes.name: NeuronEnsembles
nodes.summary: Detects cell assemblies via PCA eigenvalue thresholding plus ICA weight estimation, then tracks assembly activation strength over time.

nodes.name: spkepochs.py
nodes.summary: Population-spiking event detection: OFF periods, population burst events (PBEs) from smoothed MUA, and low-firing states.

nodes.name: detect_off_epochs
nodes.summary: Finds population OFF periods where multi-unit activity drops below threshold for a minimum duration.

nodes.name: detect_pbe_epochs
nodes.summary: Detects population burst events by z-scoring Gaussian-smoothed MUA and applying low/high thresholds with duration limits.

nodes.name: ratemaps.py

nodes.name: plot_ratemap

nodes.name: plot_raw

nodes.name: signals.py

nodes.name: plot_spectrogram

nodes.name: plot_signal_traces
nodes.summary: Stacks multi-channel signal traces with per-channel offsets and optional channel labels.

nodes.name: spikes.py

nodes.name: plot_raster

nodes.name: plot_binned_raster

nodes.name: plot_correlograms

nodes.name: plot_firing_rate

nodes.name: plot_waveforms

nodes.name: Neurons

nodes.name: position.py

nodes.summary: Group-level aggregator over animals: mean speed, trial speed traces, and summary plots across an experimental cohort.

nodes.name: get_stimuli_times
nodes.summary: Extracts CS/US stimulus onset times from an events table for a given session type and paradigm.

nodes.name: generate_session_names
nodes.summary: Generates canonical session-name lists for a given trace-FC paradigm.

nodes.name: fix_date
nodes.summary: Normalizes heterogeneous date strings into a consistent parseable format.

nodes.name: load_events_from_csv
nodes.summary: Loads a behavioral events CSV into a DataFrame with cleaned timestamps.

nodes.name: ca_neurons.py
nodes.summary: Calcium-imaging neuron core：CaNeurons 保存 traces/spikes/ROI 并绘图；CaNeuronReg + PairwiseMap/MultiSessionMap 负责跨 session 的 cell registration 映射。
nodes.languageNotes: Subclasses DataWriter, following NeuroPy's core-object save/load convention.

nodes.name: CaNeurons
nodes.summary: Core calcium-imaging container (traces, spikes/events, ROIs, projections) with event detection, rise-height computation, and ROI/trace plotting.

nodes.name: CaNeuronReg
nodes.summary: Cross-session cell registration object: aligns ROIs across sessions, overlays registered neurons, and loads pairwise mapping files.

nodes.name: PairwiseMap
nodes.summary: Lightweight holder for a pairwise session-to-session neuron index map with numpy/load conversion.

nodes.name: MultiSessionMap
nodes.summary: Chains pairwise maps into multi-session neuron identity tracks; supports stepwise registration and transitive consistency testing.

nodes.name: id_and_plot_reference_cells
nodes.summary: Identifies matching reference cells between two CaNeurons sessions and plots the overlaid ROIs.

nodes.name: detect_roi_edges
nodes.summary: Extracts contour edges from a binary ROI mask.

nodes.name: dlcio.py
nodes.summary: DeepLabCut 位置追踪的 IO 与预处理层：DLC class 读取 h5 tracking、对齐 miniscope/optitrack 时间戳、做平滑与 speed 计算，并提供 1d/2d 绘图。

nodes.name: DLC
nodes.summary: Main DeepLabCut tracking wrapper: loads h5 pose data, derives sample rate/timestamps, converts to cm, masks on-maze frames, smooths positions and computes speed.

nodes.name: get_matching_files
nodes.summary: Finds files in a directory matching an include pattern while excluding others.

nodes.name: smooth_pos
nodes.summary: Low-pass filters and interpolates DLC position traces, gating on likelihood and interpolation limits.

nodes.name: calculate_speed
nodes.summary: Computes per-bodypart speed from smoothed positions with pixel-to-cm scaling.

nodes.name: plot_1d
nodes.summary: Plots a single DLC feature over time with likelihood-based masking.

nodes.name: plot_2d
nodes.summary: Plots the 2d trajectory of a bodypart with likelihood cutoff and cm scaling.

nodes.name: minianio.py
nodes.summary: Minian CNMF 输出 (zarr) 的加载器：MinianIO 读取 traces/spikes/ROI，做 curation 与 trimming，并转成 CaNeurons 对象。

nodes.name: MinianIO
nodes.summary: Loads Minian zarr outputs (C/S/A footprints, unit ids), supports saving curated neuron subsets, trimming, and conversion to a CaNeurons object.

nodes.name: fix_dim_mismatch
nodes.summary: Repairs a corrupted zarr variable whose dimension coords mismatch a known-good zarr.

nodes.name: save_zarr_to_numpy
nodes.summary: Serializes zarr variables to .npy files for faster downstream loading.

nodes.name: miniscopeio.py
nodes.summary: Miniscope 采集文件夹的 IO：解析 recording metadata、拼接跨 recording 的 timestamps 与 head-orientation (quaternion→euler)，并整理文件到 combined folder。

nodes.name: MiniscopeIO
nodes.summary: Session-level miniscope IO object that concatenates timestamps and head-orientation data across all recordings in a folder.

nodes.name: load_timestamps
nodes.summary: Loads and concatenates miniscope/webcam timestamp CSVs for a recording folder, handling corrupted videos.

nodes.name: load_orientation
nodes.summary: Loads head-orientation (IMU quaternion) data for a recording folder and converts to usable angles.

nodes.name: move_files_to_combined_folder
nodes.summary: Moves/copies recording files into a combined folder, optionally prepending recording date/time to filenames.

nodes.name: get_recording_metadata
nodes.summary: Parses metaData.json for a miniscope recording folder into a metadata dict.

nodes.name: euler_from_quaternion
nodes.summary: Converts a quaternion to roll/pitch/yaw Euler angles.

nodes.name: movie.py
nodes.summary: Behavior tracking video 的轻量 OpenCV 封装：帧数/帧率查询、抓帧绘图，以及从文件名推断录像起始时间。

nodes.name: tracking_movie
nodes.summary: OpenCV-backed tracking video wrapper exposing frame count, frame rate, frame grabbing and frame plotting.

nodes.name: get_nframes_manual
nodes.summary: Counts video frames by iterating when the container metadata is unreliable.

nodes.name: deduce_starttime_from_file
nodes.summary: Infers a recording start datetime from the video filename or file metadata.

nodes.name: optitrackio.py
nodes.summary: Optitrack motion-capture IO：从 CSV/FBX 解析位置轨迹、采样率与起始时间，插值缺失点，并按 datetime 对齐输出 Position 对象。

nodes.name: OptitrackIO
nodes.summary: Folder-level Optitrack loader that parses all take files, concatenates tracks by datetime, and exports a core Position object.

nodes.name: posfromCSV
nodes.summary: Parses an Optitrack CSV export into x/y/z position arrays with unit handling.

nodes.name: posfromFBX
nodes.summary: Parses an Optitrack FBX export, extracting per-frame rigid-body position tracks.

nodes.name: interp_missing_pos
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates dropped-frame gaps in x/y/z position traces.

nodes.name: timestamps_from_oe
nodes.summary: Derives Optitrack sync timestamps from OpenEphys recording files.

nodes.name: getStartTime
nodes.summary: Reads the take start time from an Optitrack file header.

nodes.name: getnframes_fbx
nodes.summary: Reads frame count from an FBX file header.

nodes.name: getSampleRate
nodes.summary: Reads the capture frame rate from an Optitrack file header.

nodes.name: .readthedocs.yaml
nodes.summary: Read the Docs v2 构建配置：Ubuntu 24.04 + Python 3.11，用 Sphinx 从 docs_sphinx/conf.py 构建文档。Python requirements 安装段被注释掉。

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project entry-point doc for NeuroPy: overview, minimum requirements (py3.9/numpy/scipy), mamba-based installation, pre-use data prep steps, a raster-plot quick example, CCGViewer GUI launch note, and the citation block.

nodes.name: FUTURE_STEPS.md
nodes.summary: CCG GUI 的未建功能 backlog（2026-07-27 创建）：JitterDataset 持久化、cd-owned batch-request store、拆解 CustomCCGState、ticket 归属 CustomCCGManager、segment 完整性检查、以及一串 UI todo（含 CS-grid 下沉到 backend）。
nodes.languageNotes: Stub-only features: 文中明确说明这些 API 目前 raise NotImplementedError 或无调用方。

nodes.name: design.md
nodes.summary: A flat list of design principles governing UI code placement and growth: prefer simplification over addition, push code into ui component files rather than ccg_ui.py, manager classes over CCGReviewUI, computation into analyses/ms_connectivity.py, generic UI logic into ui utils.py, and name handlers after their widget.

nodes.name: ccg_classifier.py
nodes.summary: CCG 形状分类层：提供三套互补的 classifier —— 基于手工特征的 CCGClassifier、基于降维嵌入的 CCGClusterClassifier，以及基于模板打分的 CCGTemplateClassifier —— 用于把 cross-correlogram 归入 monosynaptic connection types。
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclasses (ClassifyResult, PeakRule, GroupTemplate) as typed records, plus a custom json.JSONEncoder subclass (_NumpyEncoder) to serialize numpy scalars/arrays when persisting templates and snapshots.

nodes.name: CCGClassifier
nodes.summary: Feature-based CCG classifier：从 CCG 波形提取 peak/trough/FWHM 等特征 (_compute_features, _find_peaks, _fwhm)，fit/predict connection type，并支持 training snapshot 与 speculated label 的存取。

nodes.name: CCGClusterClassifier
nodes.summary: Unsupervised clustering classifier：把 CCG（及 waveform）投影到低维 embedding 后聚类，通过 plot_embedding 可视化簇结构以辅助人工审阅。

nodes.name: CCGTemplateClassifier
nodes.summary: Template-matching classifier：加载/保存 group templates 与 PeakRule 集合，对 smoothed CCG 逐 template 打分 (score_pair, _score_template, _conv_rule_score) 并给出 predict 结果和可解释的 score_pair_detail。

nodes.name: ClassifyResult
nodes.summary: Typed record holding a single classification outcome (label plus supporting scores/metadata) returned by the classifiers' predict paths.

nodes.name: PeakRule
nodes.summary: Declarative rule describing an expected CCG peak (lag window, sign, amplitude constraints) used by the template scorer.

nodes.name: GroupTemplate
nodes.summary: A named connection-type template: bundles the reference CCG shape and its PeakRule set for template-based scoring.

nodes.name: _NumpyEncoder
nodes.summary: json.JSONEncoder subclass converting numpy scalars and arrays to plain Python types so templates and snapshots serialize cleanly.

nodes.name: ccgconfig_to_main_template
nodes.summary: Bridges CCGConfig into the template system：把 config 中的 bin/duration 等参数转换成一个 main GroupTemplate，使 template classifier 与主 CCG pipeline 对齐。

nodes.name: Calls2python.m
nodes.summary: MATLAB helper that converts a DeepSqueak USV detection file into a `*_cell.mat` (calls_keys + calls_data cells) readable from Python by neuropy.io.usvio.DeepSqueakIO.
nodes.languageNotes: MATLAB `table2cell` is required because MATLAB tables are not loadable by scipy.io.loadmat — cell arrays are the interop lingua franca.

nodes.name: ca_events.py
nodes.summary: Calcium-imaging event plotting layer：Raster / RasterGroup 负责围绕 event 构建 peri-event raster、baseline 与 shuffled 对照，plot_pe_traces 画单细胞 peri-event traces。

nodes.name: Raster
nodes.summary: Builds a peri-event raster for one cell：generate_raster / generate_shuffled_raster_ 生成真实与打乱对照矩阵，get_baseline、get_mean_peak/trough 提供统计量，get_start_ends_* 处理 event 边界解析。

nodes.name: RasterGroup
nodes.summary: Population-level wrapper over many Raster objects：generate_rasters 批量构建、cell_slice 取子集、sort_rasters + snake_plot 产生按响应时间排序的 snake plot。

nodes.name: plot_pe_traces
nodes.summary: Plots peri-event activity traces for a single cell with configurable pre/post buffers, optional raw trace overlay, and event-type colour coding.

nodes.name: dataviz.py
nodes.summary: Seaborn-style plotting helpers (lineplot / boxplot / pointplot / barplot) with a shared hue+x palette convention, so figures across the package look consistent.

nodes.name: lineplot
nodes.summary: Draws a hue-grouped line plot with confidence intervals onto a supplied or newly created axis.

nodes.name: boxplot
nodes.summary: Draws a grouped box plot supporting independent hue and x-category palettes plus explicit box width control.

nodes.name: pointplot
nodes.summary: Draws a point plot (group means with error bars) forwarding extra kwargs to the underlying seaborn call.

nodes.name: barplot
nodes.summary: Draws a grouped bar plot mirroring boxplot's dual-palette and width conventions.

nodes.name: CCGUI Display.md
nodes.summary: CCG review GUI 的权威 UI 规格书 (73 sections)：逐面板描述 menubar、pair selection、main CCG view、neuron network、all-session view、time slider，并附 data structures、future onboarding 计划、code style 与 glossary。

nodes.name: setup.py
nodes.summary: setuptools packaging script for the `neuropy-bapungiri` distribution：声明 numpy/scipy/matplotlib/scikit-learn 等运行依赖，README.md 作为 long_description，Python >= 3.8。

layers.name: CCG Review GUI 层
layers.description: PySide6/pyqtgraph 单突触连接审阅桌面应用：AppState 中央状态、主窗口 ccg_ui、以及 CCG/jitter/network/time-slider/pair-selection 等面板与 export、stats、menubar。

layers.name: Monosynaptic Connectivity 子系统
layers.description: CCG 连接性分析与其 UI-facing 数据模型：CCGDataset/CCGConfig/EranConv、jitter 显著性检验、CCG 归一化变换与形状分类、spike attribution，以及重构中从 GUI 抽出的 NeuronsDataset/SelectionData 状态模型与 Savable 持久化工具。

layers.name: 通用 Ephys 分析层
layers.description: 与 CCG 无关的科学分析算法库：place fields、Bayesian decoders、brain-state scoring、LFP oscillations/ripples、reactivation (EV/REV)、artifact 检测、cluster stability 与 trace-FC 行为分析。

layers.name: Core 数据原语层
layers.description: 被上层普遍依赖的领域基础对象——DataWriter 基类、Neurons/CaNeurons、Epoch/Intervals/Event、Signal、Position、Ratemap、Probe/Shank、Session 与 sync；不向上依赖任何分析或 UI 代码。

layers.name: 采集与文件 IO 层
layers.description: 把各类采集系统与外部格式读成 core 对象的 loaders：OpenEphys、Neuroscope、Phy、SpykingCircus、NWB、binary LFP，以及行为侧的 DeepLabCut、Miniscope/MiniAn、OptiTrack、USV 与 movie。

layers.name: Matplotlib 绘图层
layers.description: 基于 matplotlib/seaborn 的静态可视化 helpers——CCG、spikes、ratemaps、epochs、signals、probe、position、Ca events 与 dataviz 布局工具；供脚本/notebook 与部分 UI 复用。

layers.name: 项目文档与打包配置
layers.description: 仓库级支撑文件：README、design.md UI 代码放置原则、FUTURE_STEPS backlog、GUI 显示说明、setup.py 打包脚本、Read-the-Docs 构建配置，以及顶层 package barrel。
